description.short_caption: Axial T2-weighted MRI of the brain showing a ring-enhancing lesion.
description.detailed_description: This axial T2-weighted MRI image of the brain demonstrates a well-defined, hyperintense ring-enhancing lesion in the right basal ganglia region. Surrounding vasogenic edema is evident, with mass effect causing midline shift. The lesion's appearance is suggestive of an infectious or neoplastic process, such as an abscess or metastasis. The image is de-identified and suitable for educational purposes.
visible_findings: ring-enhancing lesion in right basal ganglia

description.short_caption: Gram stain of brain biopsy showing gram-positive cocci.
description.detailed_description: This image shows a Gram stain of brain biopsy tissue under a microscope. The field contains numerous gram-positive cocci, which appear as small, round, pink to red structures. The background consists of cellular debris and tissue matrix. The staining highlights the bacterial morphology, suggesting an infectious etiology involving gram-positive organisms.
visible_findings: pink to red staining of bacteria
